scope: Static renderer inspection; Windows binaries not executed. Native service side effects are not fully traced.
observations: Active system screen selects the V2023 app-mode-nitro component because IsV2023 returns true.
Active setACMode explicitly requests Auto for Quiet; it does not explicitly request Maximum for Turbo.
Legacy app-mode explicitly requests Maximum for Turbo but is not the active V2023 screen.
CheckFanControl requests Maximum for the TurboButton lock path; newer configurable mode-switch key paths can differ.
Custom CPU/GPU sliders send changes immediately and support independent Auto toggles.
Neo Control differs: manual sliders require Apply, both fans share Auto/Maximum/manual modes, closing restores Auto, no physical hotkey handler.
follow_up: Historical Neo Control comparison predates the background-close fix and GNOME PredatorSense shortcut. Current behavior is documented in README.md.
